name: swayari-enterprises
description: SWAYARI ENTERPRISES - Two-Portal Architecture: Customer Storefront & Admin Portal

scripts.build:storefront: node scripts/sync-assets.js storefront && vite build --config apps/storefront/vite.config.ts apps/storefront
scripts.build:admin: node scripts/sync-assets.js admin && vite build --config apps/admin/vite.config.ts apps/admin
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-manifest.js && npm run build:storefront && npm run build:admin
scripts.dev:storefront: cd apps/storefront && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --d1 DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state --binding ENVIRONMENT=development --compatibility-date 2024-09-23 --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat
scripts.dev:admin: cd apps/admin && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8789 --d1 DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state --binding ENVIRONMENT=development --compatibility-date 2024-09-23 --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat
